mapper.select: SELECT FROM media WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = #{isDeleted} ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM media WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_favorite = #{isFavorite} ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM media WHERE album_id = #{albumId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM media WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND category_id = #{categoryId} AND is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM media WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND media_type = #{mediaType} AND is_deleted = #{isDeleted} ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM media WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = FALSE AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY id
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(file_size), 0) FROM media WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO media (filename, original_filename, file_path, file_size, file_type, media_type, title, description, category_id, album_id, user_id, cover_image, view_count, is_favorite, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{filename}, #{originalFilename}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{fileType}, #{mediaType}, #{title}, #{description}, #{category.id}, #{album.id}, #{userId}, #{coverImage}, #{viewCount}, #{isFavorite}, #{isDeleted}, NOW(), NOW())
